course.name: Humbled Trader
course.tagline: Day trading education focused on small-cap and large-cap momentum strategies, combining a self-paced video course with live community mentorship.
course.about: Humbled Trader is a day trading education platform run by Shay Huang, centered on small-cap and large-cap momentum trading. The core product is the Humbled Trader Academy, a self-paced video course, usually bundled with a paid community membership that adds live mentorship, webinars and a private Discord.

curriculum.title: Humbled Trader Academy
topics: What to expect from the Academy
Trader psychology & longevity in the market

curriculum.title: Included with community membership
topics: Advanced strategy courses and trading masterminds

formats.label: Video lessons
formats.description: Self-paced Academy course — third-party reviews report around 150+ video lessons across 17 units.

formats.label: Live mentorship & webinars
formats.description: Midday livestream mentorship sessions, weekly webinars and live trade reviews with Shay and other coaches.

formats.label: Community access
formats.description: Private Discord community, including a dedicated channel for new traders.

formats.label: Downloadable resources
formats.description: Trade planning templates and scanner set-ups for platforms like thinkorswim and Interactive Brokers.

pricing.billing_note: Academy course access plus community membership, billed annually.
